newsitem.title: USA: Florida approves $220 million transportation GOs.
newsitem.headline: Florida approves $220 million transportation GOs.

text.p: Florida cabinet officials approved a $220 million general obligation refunding bond issue for the Jacksonville Transporation Authority on Monday.

The senior lien refunding bonds, series 1997, are state GOs, with debt service paid primarily from a Duval County half-cent sales surtax, with a secondary pledge of county motor fuel and special fuel tax revenues.
Cabinet officials, including the governor, comptroller and treasurer, also approved an $11.29 million Florida Housing Finance Agency revenue bond issue, for the Heron Park Project in Naples.
